Q threshold converse found: list complementary pairs {A,A^c} of subsets [t] in a fixed order. Each maximal intersect family chooses exactly one from each pair. For coordinate j, lex-order families, preferring at each pair the side containing j. For F vs G their earliest differing pair selects A∈F\G; coordinate j ranks F>G iff j∈A. For F vs G,H earliest-difference sides A,B belong to F so intersect; a j∈A∩B ranks F above both. Thus λ(t) families admit t 3-suitable orders; insert each 2-set directly after its later vertex to realize Q. Therefore dim Q_n=min{t:n≤λ(t)} (n≥2).
